items.title: Constitution promulgated
items.text: The sultan promulgated the Kanun-i Esasi on 23 December 1876.

items.title: First parliament opens
items.text: The first Ottoman parliament opened on 19 March 1877.

items.title: Parliament suspended
items.text: Parliament was adjourned indefinitely on 14 February 1878.

items.title: Constitution restored
items.text: The constitution was restored in July 1908 after a revolt by officers and troops in Macedonia. This marker locates that regional context, not one exact meeting.
